verdict.rationale: The axis applies because TeamViewer ships AI features: Tia, an AI agent that "learns from every support session," plus AI session summaries and an AI troubleshooting assistant. However, the evidence pack contains nothing documenting an opt-out, admin control, or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Community items do not address AI training at all.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
